load_shedding_tips1: This function intelligently charges the energy storage system according to the power outage schedule in your area and the set cut-off charging SOC, ensuring that you and your family can have enough backup energy during power outages. Activating this function may cause an increase in household electricity bills.
load_shedding_tips2: After turning on this function, the system will perform intelligent power backup based on local power outage conditions. This function is a forced charging operation. If you want to stop charging, please perform the "Charge and Discharge Settings" - "Stop Charging" operation.
load_shedding_tips3: After turning on this function, a power backup information reminder will be sent to you based on the local power outage situation.
